name: Coca-Cola Atlanta Beverage Base Plant - Atlanta GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled entrance drive off the southwest connector road; z21 satellite shows a small structure with the drive splitting into lanes around it and a barrier across the lane.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small dark-roofed booth sits in the entrance drive (z21 satellite); Street View obscured by trees so flagged as uncertain, but layout strongly indicates a staffed/controlled booth.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Diagonal trailer-parking stalls along the northwest building face hold ~15-20 trailers; modest on-site drop yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~16 doors along the west building face; process-plant layout makes exact count uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail line passes through a corridor north of the property serving an adjacent warehouse; no spur enters this facility.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach drive from the gate around the west side to the dock area.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside Atlanta's dense Fulton Industrial Boulevard / I-285 industrial fabric.
